visualCharacteristics.purpose: banking / mortgage page hero: eyebrow, heading, short copy and one or two CTAs on the left, a photo cropped to a chevron (or rounded) shape on the right

contentPattern.structure: optional picture-only row(s) for the photo, then the copy cell (eyebrow paragraph, heading, text, optional list, CTA links); the photo may instead share the copy's row (cell order sets the photo side). Further rows become a product-details strip, one column per cell. A cell holding only a link to a /fragments/ page is replaced by that fragment. Background colour comes from the section style (dark, blue) or the dark option

usage: Use at the top of banking, mortgage, home-equity and small-business pages. Default crops the photo to a chevron; rounded-image uses a rounded rectangle photo; rounded-image-chevron-photo rounds the chevron tip; image shows the photo uncropped; rounded-image-product-details adds a bordered, divided product-details strip from extra rows. Set the section style to dark or blue (or add dark) for light text.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any non-card product hero with a lifestyle photo. Use hero-card for credit-card offers with a card image and hero-photo for text laid over a full-bleed photo.
